whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: depth fits the day, and a rushed tester isn't fished for more.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the voice note and celebrates briefly. Maya sounds rushed, so it asks at most one light question in all (for example "Same size tomorrow?"), never a follow-up on the chapter's content after "ok fine, busy day". It wraps up quickly in a line acknowledging she's busy, with the next step day's step fully defined (chapter 5, on the couch, 8 pm, about 20 minutes, the same size), and asks if it works. After "sure" it confirms in a line with no new question. No text ever chases a longer reflection.
